system.description:
MIRAKU

The spirit bound to your soul protects you against forces that would displace, dominate or corrupt it.

You gain a +2 racial bonus to saving throws against possession and effects with the Soul trait.

Furthermore, whenever you make a Fortitude or Reflex saving throw against an effect created by a spirit, haunt or incorporeal creature, you may use your Wisdom modifier in place of the normal ability modifier for that saving throw if it is higher.

Automated: +2 racial on saves against effects with the Soul trait (applied) or against possession (tick). On a Fortitude or Reflex save against a spirit, haunt or incorporeal creature, Wisdom stands in for Constitution or Dexterity when it is higher, offered as a tick (a save cannot see that its source is a spirit: spirit and incorporeal are traits, not creature types).
